prompt: Our Umbraco 17 site needs to answer 410 Gone for pages editors unpublish. Step one: whenever a page is unpublished, store the URL it had so a content finder can match it later. Write the notification handler and its registration.
expectations: The handler subscribes to ContentUnpublishingNotification, not ContentUnpublishedNotification
The agent explains that the pre-notification runs before the page leaves the published cache, so its URL can still be read
The URL is read from the published cache via IUmbracoContextFactory.EnsureUmbracoContext() inside a using
The handler is registered with builder.AddNotificationHandler in an IComposer
Any Umbraco docs links point at the 17.latest pages, not the unversioned (v18) pages
If no buildable project is available, the agent does not claim the handler was compiled or run
